description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Config, which manages configuration directives for HTML Purifier, including loading, setting, and retrieving configuration options, as well as schema management and finalization status.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Config
classes.description: A class managing the configuration directives for HTML Purifier, allowing loading, modification, retrieval, and finalization of configuration settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the configuration object with a schema definition.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a configuration object from various inputs such as array, string filename, or existing object.

methods.name: createDefault
methods.description: Creates a default configuration object using the global schema instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific directive within a namespace.

methods.name: getBatch
methods.description: Retrieves all directives within a specific namespace as an associative array.

methods.name: getBatchSerial
methods.description: Returns a unique md5 serial hash for a namespace's batch of directives.

methods.name: getSerial
methods.description: Returns a md5 serial hash representing the entire configuration object.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all current directives organized by namespace.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a directive value within a namespace, handling aliases and type validation.

methods.name: _listify
methods.description: Helper for creating a comma-separated list of allowed directive values.

methods.name: getHTMLDefinition
methods.description: Returns the HTML definition object, raw by default.

methods.name: getCSSDefinition
methods.description: Returns the CSS definition object, raw by default.

methods.name: getDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves a specific type of definition object, optionally raw.

methods.name: loadArray
methods.description: Loads configuration directives from an associative array.

methods.name: getAllowedDirectivesForForm
methods.description: Returns directives allowed in form context based on schema and allowed list.

methods.name: loadArrayFromForm
methods.description: Creates a configuration object from $_GET/$_POST arrays for form submission.

methods.name: mergeArrayFromForm
methods.description: Merges configuration directives from form input into existing configuration.

methods.name: prepareArrayFromForm
methods.description: Prepares an array from form data into directives format, handling nulls and magic quotes.

methods.name: loadIni
methods.description: Loads directives from an ini file.

methods.name: isFinalized
methods.description: Checks if the configuration has been finalized, optionally triggers an error.

methods.name: autoFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the config if autoFinalize is enabled and not already finalized.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Marks the configuration as finalized, preventing further changes.
